stories.event: Blumar salmon business acquisition, announced 4-5 Nov
stories.title: Agrosuper signs agreement to buy Blumar's salmon business for up to US$540 million
stories.summary: Agrosuper, owner of AquaChile, signed a memorandum of understanding to acquire 100% of Salmones Blumar at up to US$540m (€479m). The two firms are negotiating the definitive contracts, and the deal would create the world's second-largest producer. Press also reports Multi X exploring a purchase of Ventisqueros, and that other Chilean farmers are up for sale.

stories.title: Scottish Sea Farms opens Billy Baa, Scotland's largest salmon farm, in Shetland after £7.5m investment
stories.summary: The Billy Baa site, west of South Whiteness and Weisdale Voe, is consented for up to 4,091 tonnes of salmon at any one time. It is the country's largest marine salmon farm by capacity and represents a £7.5m (€9m) investment. A Shetland MSP and local school children took part in the opening, and the company is giving the local primary school £10k for new books.

top.why: Agrosuper signed an MoU to buy Blumar's salmon business for up to US$540m, which would create the world's second-largest producer and may start further consolidation in Chile.
Mowi posted record Q3 revenue, raised 2026 harvest guidance to 620,000 tonnes and guided 630,000 tonnes for 2027, with only 17% of Q4 volume contracted in Norway.
Lerøy's Q3 operational EBIT jumped to NOK 459m on lower farming costs and better biology despite lower harvest, and it sees low volume growth ahead.
BioMar posted record Q3 results with salmon-division profit up 88% and raised its guidance, while flagging a softer Q4 amid uncertainty over ingredient prices.
Peru's second anchoveta season was canceled and the El Niño alert now runs to autumn 2027, raising fish oil supply and feed cost concerns.
